senses.gloss: तारक- + अक्ष तारक- + अक्ष, 1. adj. having stars for eyes. 2. m. a proper name.
तारा- + अधिप तारा- + अधिप, m. the moon, Rām. 3, 58, 4.
तारा- + गण तारा- + गण, m. a multitude of stars, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 2743.
तर्क- + ग्रन्थ तर्क- + ग्रन्थ, m. a compendium of logic, Suśr. 2, 360, 13.

तर तर, i. e. तॄ + अ,
 I. adj. Conquering, MBh. 12, 10380.
 II. m.
 1. Passage, crossing, Man. 8, 407.
 2. Freight, Man. 8, 406.
 3. A certain spell for banishing demons, Rām. 1, 30, 4.
 --Comp.

तार तार,
 A. i. e. तॄ + अ,
 I. adj.
 1. Saving, MBh. 13, 6986.
 2. Piercing, Mṛcch. 44, 10; ˚र + म्, adv. Sounding loud, 92, 13.
 II. m. and n. A shrill loud sound, MBh. 7, 6737.
 III. m.
 1. A pearl, Gīt. 11, 25.
 2. A proper name, Rām. 1, 3, 24.
 B. (for original स्तार, cf. 3. स्तृ),
 I. (m.), f. रा (and n.),
 1. A star, Rām. 1, 35, 16.
 2. The pupil of the eye, Ṛt. 6, 31.
 II. f. रा,
 1. A certain meteor, perhaps a shootingstar, Varāh. Bṛh. S. 32, 1.
 C. f. रा.
 1. The knowledge which arises from reasoning in regard to the principles, the conditions of intellect, the elemental creation, Tattvas. 41 Ball.
 2. The name of deities, MBh. 5, 3972; of a monkey, Rām. 1, 1, 67.
 D. n. Silver, Bhāg. P. 4, 6, 27.
 --Comp.
तरक्षु तरक्षु, m. A hyena, Rām. 2, 94, 7.
तरङ्ग् तरङ्ग्, a denomin. derived from the next, Par. To move to and fro, Gīt. 2, 8.

तरङ्ग तरङ्ग, i. e. तर + म् + ग, m.
 1. A wave, Pañc. 263, 20; signifying a section of a book, Kathās.
 2. The gallop of a horse, Gīt. 12, 20.
 3. Moving to and fro, Hariv. 4298.
 --Comp.

तरङ्गित तरङ्गित, i. e. तरङ्ग + इत,
 I. adj.
 1. Wavy, MBh. 6, 3851.
 2. Overflowing, Kathās. 18, 223.
 II. n. Moving to and fro, Gīt. 3, 13. 3.

तरङ्गिन् तरङ्गिन्, i. e. तरङ्ग + इन्,
 I. adj., f. इणी.
 1. Wavy, Rām. 2, 71, 2.
 2. Unsteady, Gīt. 5, 19.
 II. f. इणी, A river, Bhartṛ. 3, 65.
 --Comp.

तरण तरण, i. e. तॄ + अन, n.
 1. Passing over, crossing, Rām. 6, 11, 4.
 2. Overcoming, MBh. 1, 6054.
 --Comp.

तारण तारण, i. e. तॄ + अन,
 I. adj., f. णी, Saving, Hariv. 7022.
 II. n.
 1. Crossing, passing over, Mṛcch. 146, 25.
 2. Overcoming, MBh. 4, 135.
 3. Saving, MBh. 1, 1050.
 4. An implement of sacrifice(?), MBh. 14, 2668.

तरणि तरणि, i. e. तॄ + अनि,
 I. adj., f. णी, Overcoming, Hariv. 14078.
 II. m.
 1. The sun, Bhāg. P. 5, 1, 30.
 2. (? or f.), A boat, Prab. 83, 10.
तरत्समन्दीय तरत्समन्दीय, i. e. तरत् स मन्दी + इय, n. A hymn of the Rigveda (9, 58), beginning तरत् स मन्दी, Man. 11, 253.

तरल तरल, i. e. तॄ + अल,
 I. adj., f. ला.
 1. Trembling, tremulous, MBh. 1, 1234; 4, 269.
 2. Sparkling, Śāk. d. 25.
 3. Fickle, Rājat. 3, 515.
 II. m. The central gem of a necklace, MBh. 8, 4913.
 III. f. ला, Spirituous liquor, Varāh. Bṛh. S. 75, 12.
तरलता तरल + ता, f. Sprightliness, Pañc. i. d. 205.

तरलय तरलय, a denomin. derived from तरल, Par.
 1. To cause to tremble, Amar. 87.
 2. To move to and fro, Gīt. 12, 15.

तरस् तरस्, i. e. तॄ + अस्,
 1. Speed (ved.).
 2. Energy, Rām. 5, 77, 18.
 3. Strength, Ragh. 11, 77. Instr. ˚सा, adv. Speedily, Hiḍ. 4, 2.

तरस्विन् तरस् + विन्, adj., f. नी.
 1. Swift, energetic, Bhāg. P. 8, 20, 31; MBh. 1, 2546.
 2. Bold, Śāk. 90, 19.
तराम् + तराम्, acc. sing. f. of the aff. तर, is joined to indeclinables, i. e. verbs and adverbs in the signification of a comparative, Pañc. i. d. 368.
तरि and तरी तरी̆, i. e. तॄ + ई̆, f. A boat, MBh. 1, 4014; 4228.
तरिक तरिक, i. e. तर + इक, m. A ferry-man, Yājñ. 2, 263.
तारिक तारिक, i. e. तॄ + इक, n. Toll for passage, Man. 8, 407.
तरित्र तरित्र, i. e. तॄ + त्र, n. A boat, MBh. 5, 2436.

तरु तरु, i. e. तॄ + उ (for original तर् + वन्), m. A tree, Rām. 6, 82, 115.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. perhaps Lat. termes.

तरुण तरुण, i. e. तॄ + वन् + अ (cf. the last),
 I. adj., f. णी.
 1. Young, MBh. 4, 1108.
 2. Fresh, Suśr. 1, 191, 8.
 3. Vivid, Bhartṛ. 3, 86.
 4. Beginning, [] Suśr. 2, 52, 16.
 II. m. A young man, Pañc. i. d. 11.
 III. f. णी, A young woman, Rām. 3, 59, 1; Daśak. in Chr. 186, 22.
 IV. n. Cartilage, Suśr. 1, 35, 1.
 --Cf. τέρην, τέρεινα.

तरुणाय तरुणाय, a denomin. derived from the last by य, Ātm.
 1. To become young, Hariv. 4745.
 2. To remain young, Pañc. v. d. 15.
तरुता तरु + ता, f. Condition of a tree, being a tree, Mārk. P. 31, 9.

तर्क् तर्क्, i. 10, Par. (in epic poetry also Ātm, Hariv. 11402),
 1. To suppose, Rām. 5, 18, 22.
 2. To utter one's supposition, Śāk. 83, 5, v. r.
 3. To find out, Kathās. 26, 18; Nal. 11, 36.
 4. To reflect, MBh. 3, 1723.
 5. To bear in mind, MBh. 5, 1895.
 6. To intend, MBh. 3, 1894.
 7. † To shine or speak.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. तर्कित, n. Supposition, Hariv. 9467. अ-, adj. Unexpected, Hariv. 4467.
 --Ptcple. of the fut. pass. तर्कणीय, To be suspected, MBh. 5, 1093.
 --Comp.
 --With the prep. अनु अनु,
 1. To suppose, Bhāg. P. 1, 18, 32.
 2. To bear in mind, MBh. 3, 1722.
 --With परि परि, To reflect, Rām. 5, 30, 18. अ-परितर्कित, adj.
 1. Not examined, Rām. 2, 109, 16.
 2. Unexpected, Hariv. 4500.
 --With प्र प्र, To search, to investigate, MBh. 12, 6687. अ-प्रतर्क्य, adj. Undiscoverable by reason, inconceivable, Man. 1, 5.
 --With संप्र सम्-प्र, To think, Hariv. 13804.
 --With वि वि,
 1. To suppose, Pañc. 35, 5.
 2. To guess, MBh. 1, 3571.
 3. To take for, Suśr. 1, 298, 17.
 4. To reflect, Rām. 5, 35, 39.
 5. To infer, Kathās. 7, 67. अ-वितर्कित, adj. Not anticipated, Rām. 2, 69, 21. दुर्वि-तर्क्य, [] i. e. दुस्-, adj. Hard to be imagined, Bhāg. P. 7, 10, 53.
 --With संवि सम्-वि, To reflect, MBh. 4, 234.
 --With सम् सम्, To take for, MBh. 1, 6540.
 --Cf. ἀ-τρεκής, probably also ἄ-τρακτος (cf. तर्कु); Lat. torquere, torcular, torques, torvus; O.H.G. drajan; N.G. drehen.

तर्क तर्क् + अ,
 I. m.
 1. Supposition, Rām. 5, 71, 12.
 2. Consideration, Pañc. iii. d. 258.
 3. Logical reasoning, logic, Man. 12, 106; MBh. 2, 453.
 4. A philosophical system, Prab. 86, 14.
 II. f. का, Logical reasoning, MBh. 4, 892.
 --Comp.
तर्कक तर्क + क, adj. Poor(?), MBh. 12, 1537.

तर्किन् तर्किन्, adj., f. इणी.
 1. i. e. तर्क् + इन्, Supposing, Śāk. 103, 19.
 2. i. e. तर्क + इन्, Skilled in speculation, Man. 12, 111.
तर्कु तर्क् + उ, m.(?), A spindle.

तर्कुट तर्क् + उट,
 I. n. Spinning.
 II. f. टी, A distaff, a spindle.
 --Comp.

तर्ज् तर्ज्, i. 1, Par. (in epic poetry also Ātm., MBh. 7, 6131),
 1. To menace, Rām. 2, 96, 26.
 2. To blame, MBh. 8, 1543.
 --Caus. and i. 10, Ātm.
 1. To menace, Ragh. 12, 41.
 2. To blame, Hariv. 11166.
 3. To terrify, Rām. 6, 98, 31.
 4. To ridicule, MBh. 5, 2485. तर्जित, n. Menacing, Rām. 5, 66, 22.
 --With अभि अभि,
 1. To menace, Rām. 3, 55, 32.
 2. To blame, Ṛt. 5, 6, v. r.
 --With समभि सम्-अभि, The same, MBh. 7, 7176.
 --With परि परि, To menace, Rām. 5, 42, 9.
 --With वि वि,
 1. To menace, Bhāg. P. 8, 11, 30.
 2. To [] blame, Ṛt. 5, 6.
 --With सम् सम्,
 1. To menace, Rām. 3, 68, 43.
 2. To blame. Rām. 4, 61, 26.
 --Cf. A.S. threagan (to chide); O.H.G. drawjan; N.G. drohen.

तर्जन तर्ज् + अन,
 I. n.
 1. Menacing, Daśak. in Chr. 195, 20.
 2. Blaming, Rām. 5, 66, 3.
 3. Terrifying, MBh. 3, 12569.
 II. f. ना, Menacing, Sāh. D. 66, 11.
 III. f. नी, The forefinger, Kathās. 17, 88.
तर्णक तर्णक, probably akin to तरुण, m. A calf, Rājat. 5, 431.
तर्द् तर्द्, i. 1, Par. To kill; see तृद्.

तर्पण तर्पण, i. e. तृप् + अन, n.
 1. Satisfaction given or received, Kathās. 26, 236; MBh. 14, 673.
 2. An oblation to the deities or Manes, Yājñ. 1, 46; Man. 3, 70.
 3. Pleasing, Bhāg. P. 3, 1, 27.
 4. A sweetmeat(?), MBh. 18, 269.
 --Comp.
† तर्ब् तर्ब्, i. 1, Par. To go.
तर्ष तर्ष, i. e. तृष् + अ, m. Thirst, desire, MBh. 12, 4296.
तर्षण तर्षण, i. e. तृष् + अन, n. Desiring, Bhāg. P. 3, 25, 7.
ऽतर्षुल -तर्षुल, i. e. तृष् + उल, in अ-तर्षुल + म्, adv. Without desire, MBh. 12, 7762.

तर्हि त + र्हि, see तद् (probably for तत्र-हि), adv.
 1. At that time, Bhāg. P. 1, 8, 12.
 2. Then, therefore, Bhāg. P. 3, 9, 32.

तारक तारक,
 I. i. e. तॄ + अक, adj., f. रिका,
 1. Bringing over, Rām. 2, 97, 23 Gorr.
 2. Saving, Prab. 25, 17.
 II. m. A proper name, MBh. 6, 4249.
 III. f. रका, and n.
 1. A star (see तार
 B.), Bhāg. P. 2, 5, 11; MBh. 5, 5390.
 2. The pupil of the eye, Rām. 3, 52, 34.
तारकामय तारका + मय (तारका = तारा, [] proper name), adj., f. यी, On account of Tārā, MBh. 2, 939.
तारकित तारकित, i. e. तारका + इत, adj. Starry, bestarred, Daśak. in Chr. 179, 14.
तारणेय तारणेय, patronym. MBh. 1, 6363.

तारतम्य तारतम्य, i. e. तर-तम, the affixes of the comparative and superlative, + य, n. More or less, proportion, Bhāg. P. 5, 26, 2.
 2. State or condition, Mṛcch. 157, 20.
तारिन् तारिन्, i. e. तॄ + इन्, adj., f. इणी, Saving, MBh. 6, 797.
तारुण्य तारुण्य, i. e. तरुण + य, n. Youth, Pañc. i. d. 196.
तार्किक तार्किक, i. e. तर्क + इक, m. A dialectician, Vedāntas. in Chr. 211, 6.

तार्क्ष तार्क्ष, m.
 1. A kind of bird, Suśr. 1, 334, 11.
 2. A kind of plant, 2, 498, 19.
 3. A name of Kaśyapa, Bhāg. P. 6, 6, 2.
 4. erroneously instead of तार्क्ष्य, e. g. Hariv. 6966.

तार्क्ष्य तार्क्ष्य,
 I. m.
 1. A fabulous being, sometimes fancied as a horse, sometimes as a bird, MBh. 1, 2548. identical with Garuḍa, Hariv. 7460.
 2. A bird(?), Suśr. 2, 162, 4.
 3. A kind of antidote, Suśr. 2, 275, 21.
 II. n. A certain medicine, Suśr. 2, 69, 13.
तार्ण तार्ण, i. e. तृण + अ, adj. Made of grass, MBh. 1, 996.

तार्तीय तार्तीय, i. e. तृतीय + अ, adj.
 1. Belonging to the third, Bhāg. P. 3, 6, 29.
 2. Third, 8, 19, 34.
तारा- + पति तारा- + पति, m. 1. the moon. 2. a proper name.
तरुण- + पुत्र तरुण- + पुत्र, adj., f. रा, having young ones, Rām. 3, 53, 51.
तारा- + मृग तारा- + मृग, m. the fifth lunar constellation, Rām. 3, 49, 45.
तर्क- + विद्या तर्क- + विद्या, f. the science of reasoning or logic, Prab. 105, 8.
तर्क- + शास्त्र तर्क- + शास्त्र, n. logic, MBh. 12, 9678.
तार्क्ष्य- + शैल तार्क्ष्य- + शैल, n. a kind of collyrium, Suśr. 2, 66, 9.
तरु- + षण्ड तरु- + षण्ड and द्रुम-, n. a group of trees, Pañc. 10, 4; Rām. 4, 13, 13 (तरु-); 4, 13, 12. (द्रुम-).
तार- + स्वर तार- + स्वर, m. loud sound or voice, Pañc. 97, 19; 107, 5.
